groups.name: block-request-lifecycle
groups.contract: Bounded tags and request-private storage, validated payload/operation/limits, exact completion, real queue backpressure and joined quiescence. Reject unsupported operations before publication.
groups.test: Runtime acceptance must cover actual reads, invalid requests, exhausted tags, completion/requeue and cancellation before request release.

groups.name: unsupported-synchronous-block-api
groups.contract: The first native client uses owned asynchronous reads. Reject synchronous Linux execution/Get-ID and borrowed kernel payload mapping before request publication; leave the allocated request releasable.
groups.test: Guest acceptance must verify explicit EOPNOTSUPP, no submission, unchanged destination bytes and successful request release.

groups.name: disk-registration
groups.contract: Owned disk and queue registration with capacity, read-only and limit state; roll back partial registration and retire only after requests and callbacks drain.
groups.test: Runtime acceptance must verify capacity/range and read-only rejection, registration rollback and repeated removal.

groups.name: dma-and-scatterlist
groups.contract: Checked DMA direction, address and length; owned coherent ring/data leases and scatterlists; sync and unmap once, never recycle while device DMA can continue.
groups.test: Runtime acceptance must cover multi-segment reads, map failure, out-of-range DMA, synchronization and device-reset-before-release.

groups.name: pci-mmio-and-intx
groups.contract: Use owned PCI functions, checked configuration capabilities/BAR spans, width-correct MMIO and original INTx handler; revoke bus mastering and synchronize IRQs before release.
groups.test: Runtime acceptance must cover malformed capabilities, BAR bounds, real completion IRQs, missing devices and teardown with pending IRQ/DMA.

groups.name: execution-and-ordering
groups.contract: Reuse shared execution types, ordered scalar/IRQ-safe access and real barriers; wait off-lock and join deferred callbacks before owner destruction. Matching names alone do not prove provider ABI compatibility.
groups.test: Runtime acceptance must verify no sleeping in IRQ/locked regions, no lost completion, queue ordering and joined work cancellation.

groups.name: memory-and-containers
groups.contract: Checked and fallible allocation with correct GFP context, page ownership, bounded IDs and intrusive list lifetimes. No success-shaped allocation fallbacks.
groups.test: Runtime acceptance must inject allocation failures and ID exhaustion and verify complete rollback and no use-after-release.

groups.name: device-model
groups.contract: Explicit bus/device/driver registration and references; original probe/remove callbacks retain backing objects until joined teardown.
groups.test: Runtime acceptance must cover failed probe rollback, duplicate registration and reference-safe driver removal.

groups.name: diagnostics-and-metadata
groups.contract: Keep bounded original diagnostics and failure paths observable; metadata parsers and formatting must validate their inputs.
groups.test: Runtime acceptance must reject malformed metadata, preserve errors and bounded logs, and never convert BUG/panic into success.

groups.name: unsupported-platform-paths
groups.contract: Initial runtime admits only BSP/INTx modern PCI. MSI-X allocation must return an explicit unsupported error so original INTx fallback executes; reject SR-IOV/Xen and sanitizer modes, and admit no device-tree nodes. Audit declarations supply no fallback implementations.
groups.test: Runtime acceptance must prove unsupported vector allocation cannot claim success, INTx is selected, and unsupported platform/device features are rejected before DMA.
